name: TerraGroup Employee Fix
teaser: """Fixes""" TerraGroup Employee & others from not triggering due to a bug with quest states.
description_html:
Issue fixed in 3.11.4. Go update your SPT.

So there’s a bug in 3.11.3 that makes some quests like Colleagues - Part 3 and THP - Sadist get stuck as failed, which locks you out of any subsequent quests.

Now, backporting the fix from 4.0 is kinda above my skills, so I did the next best(?) thing and removed those two quests from the requirements of TerraGroup Employee, Swift One, and THP - Relentless.
Also tries to fix Hot Wheels - Lets Try Again. It should pop up and be acceptable if Hot Wheels is stuck as Failed.

This mod will become redundant the moment somebody with more brain wrinkles than me fixes it, but for now you can use this.

To install it, just drag and drop the contents of the archive into your SPT folder. Please use 7-Zip.
